description: The plot illustrates the training loss curves for different configurations of SepLLM in the post-training setting. The x-axis represents the number of iterations, ranging from 95,000 to 125,000, and is labeled as "#Iteration." The y-axis represents the loss, ranging from 2.0 to 3.0, and is labeled as "Loss." The plot includes four lines representing different configurations: SepLLM (n=64, larger lr) in pink, SepLLM (n=128) in blue, SepLLM (n=64) in orange, and Vanilla before post-training in red dashed. The pink line starts at a loss of approximately 2.8 and decreases to around 2.2 by the end of the iterations. The blue line starts at a loss of approximately 2.9 and decreases to around 2.3 by the end of the iterations. The orange line starts at a loss of approximately 2.8 and decreases to around 2.2 by the end of the iterations. The red dashed line remains constant at a loss of approximately 2.2 throughout the iterations.
